name: @sidioralabs/chainflow-data-gateway
description: API-key-protected SDK contract for the Chainflow public data gateway. Covers all 18 price feeds, TradingView UDF history, books/trades/stats, market summaries, EVM block observations, explorer activity, CoinGecko/CMC-compatible adapters, and WebSocket handshakes/messages. AUTHENTICATION: REST requires the REST X-API-Key. POST /auth/ws-token requires a separate WS X-API-Key. Keep both keys server-side. WebSocket clients exchange the WS key for an opaque, short-lived, scope-bound token, then connect using
author: Chainflow Data Gateway

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
